description: This file implements a plugin health check system for Mattermost, including a job that periodically checks plugin health, restarts or deactivates plugins based on failure counts, and manages failure timestamps.

classes.name: PluginHealthCheckJob
classes.description: Represents a scheduled job that performs health checks on plugins, manages failures, and handles plugin restart or deactivation.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Continuously performs health checks on active plugins at regular intervals.

methods.name: CheckPlugin
methods.description: Checks the health of a specific plugin by ID, and restarts or deactivates it based on failure history.

methods.name: getStoredTimestamps
methods.description: Retrieves stored failure timestamps for a plugin.
